_meta.amends: resource_contract.json 5.4B-R1-draft (file unchanged; this addendum takes precedence for the sections it names)

R2-1_calendar_policy.rule: An activity may occupy a tick only if the tick is inside (a) the project calendar, (b) the activity's allowed_hours when declared, and (c) the calendar of every working-time resource it demands. Elapsed holds and continuous reservations ignore calendars.

exception.effect: For the named activities, (a) is replaced by the calendars named in the exception; (b) and (c) still apply.
exception.on_missing_authorization: Apply the default policy; never infer an exception from a resource calendar.

R2-1_calendar_policy.supersedes: R1 ActivityResourceRequirement.allowed_hours note and Task 4 convention 'activity_calendar'

R2-2_mode_occupancy.rule: The selected crew mode is occupied in full for every working segment. Units without positive Stage 5.3A demand are kept as declared reservations; they are never removed silently.

fields.reserved_without_bcca_demand: object resource_id -> units, required whenever a mode unit has zero worker_hours_by_trade / machine_hours_by_class

R2-2_mode_occupancy.duration: Unchanged: Stage 5.3A productive_hours from positive-demand bounds only.
R2-2_mode_occupancy.cost: Unchanged: no cost line for reserved-without-demand units (BCCA price governs).
R2-2_mode_occupancy.validation_V5_R2: mode units == worker_capacity_by_trade + equipment_capacity_by_class + reserved_without_bcca_demand, exactly; anything else is MODEL_INVALID (MODE_MISMATCH).

fixed_timestamp.semantics: Release finish = max(pour finish + elapsed minimum, at). 'at' is an absolute bound that does not move with the pour (Agent 1 N2).

at_minimum.semantics: Release finish = pour finish + elapsed minimum (fixture only).

activity_dependent_test.semantics: Projection only: max(minimum, test age) measured from the pour, moving with the pour. Schedule status CONDITIONAL; never OPTIMAL, never releasable, never converted to a timestamp.

semantics.recorded_pass: Fixed not-before on every gated successor; at < inspection earliest finish is MODEL_INVALID (EVENT_BEFORE_ACTIVITY_FINISH).
semantics.missing: Projected as at finish; gated successors CONDITIONAL.

R2-5_controlled_fixture_exceptions.treatment: Excluded and reported unenforced; no counts introduced.
